label: Order
caption: SANOFI-AVENTIS DEUTSCHLAND GMBH V. MYLAN PHARMACEUTICALS INC.
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicant, IT IS ORDERED that the mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit, case Nos. 2019-1368 and 2019-1369, is hereby stayed pending receipt of a response, due on or before Thursday, February 13, 2020, by 4:30 p.m. ET, and further order of the undersigned or of the Court.
